column1: summarise|/ˈsʌməraɪz/|学业方法|v. 总结，概括|We should summarise the main points before we end the lesson.|我们应该在课结束前总结要点。
outline|/ˈaʊtlaɪn/|学业方法|v. 概述，列提纲|Please outline your answer before you start to write the essay.|动笔写作前请先列出答案提纲。
memorise|/ˈmeməraɪz/|学业方法|v. 记住，背诵|It is better to memorise the rule than to guess each time.|记住规则比每次猜测更好。
recall|/rɪˈkɔːl/|学业方法|v. 回忆，回想|I cannot recall the exact word he used in the lecture.|我回想不起他在课上用的原词。
quote|/kwəʊt/|学业方法|v. 引用|You should quote a reliable source to support your claim.|你应引用可靠来源来支持你的观点。
cite|/saɪt/|学业方法|v. 引用，引证|Remember to cite the author when you use her idea.|使用她的观点时记得注明作者。
draft|/drɑːft/|学业方法|v. 起草|She will draft a short plan for the group project today.|她今天将为小组项目起草简要计划。
edit|/ˈedɪt/|学业方法|v. 编辑，修改|He asked me to edit his report for clear and correct grammar.|他请我修改报告以厘清语法。
proofread|/ˈpruːfriːd/|学业方法|v. 校对|Always proofread your essay carefully before you hand it in.|交作业前务必校对你的文章。
annotate|/ˈænəʊteɪt/|学业方法|v. 做注释|We annotate the text to mark the key arguments inside.|我们在文中做注标记关键论点。
skim|/skɪm/|学业方法|v. 略读|Skim the passage first to get the general idea quickly.|先略读段落以快速把握大意。
scan|/skæn/|学业方法|v. 扫读，查找|Scan the page to find the date of the school event.|扫读页面以找到学校活动日期。
paraphrase|/ˈpærəfreɪz/|学业方法|v. 释义，改写|Try to paraphrase the sentence in your own simple words.|试着用自己的话改写这个句子。
brainstorm|/ˈbreɪnstɔːm/|学业方法|v. 头脑风暴|We brainstorm ideas together before we choose a topic.|选定主题前我们先一起头脑风暴。
retrieve|/rɪˈtriːv/|学业方法|v. 检索，找回|You can retrieve the file from the shared class folder.|你可以从共享文件夹检索文件。
absorb|/əbˈzɔːb/|学业方法|v. 吸收，理解|It takes time to absorb such difficult and new knowledge.|吸收这么难的新知识需要时间。
comprehend|/ˌkɒmprɪˈhend/|学业方法|v. 理解|Few students fully comprehend the long paragraph just yet.|还没几个学生完全理解这段长文。
recite|/rɪˈsaɪt/|学业方法|v. 背诵|He can recite the poem without looking at the book.|他能不看书背诵这首诗。
quiz|/kwɪz/|学业方法|n. 小测验|The teacher gave us a short quiz on new vocabulary.|老师给我们做了个词汇小测验。
schedule|/ˈʃedjuːl/|学业方法|n. 计划表，日程|Make a study schedule and follow it every single day.|制定学习计划并每天执行。
prioritise|/praɪˈɒrətaɪz/|学业方法|v. 优先处理|You must prioritise the tasks that matter to you most.|你必须优先处理最重要的事。
deadline|/ˈdedlaɪn/|学业方法|n. 截止日期|We finished the work before the final exam deadline arrived.|我们在最后期限前完成了工作。
syllabus|/ˈsɪləbəs/|学业方法|n. 教学大纲|The syllabus lists all the topics for this term.|大纲列出了本学期所有主题。
textbook|/ˈtekstbʊk/|学业方法|n. 教科书|Our textbook explains the grammar with clear short examples.|课本用清晰例句讲解语法。
glossary|/ˈɡlɒsəri/|学业方法|n. 词汇表|Check the glossary at the back for the hard words.|查书后词汇表了解难词。
index|/ˈɪndeks/|学业方法|n. 索引|Use the index to locate the exact page you need.|用书后索引找到所需页码。
paragraph|/ˈpærəɡrɑːf/|学业方法|n. 段落|Each paragraph should focus on one clear main idea.|每段应聚焦一个清晰观点。
thesis|/ˈθiːsɪs/|学业方法|n. 论点，论文|Your thesis must be clear and well supported by facts.|你的论点须清晰且有充分支撑。
argument|/ˈɑːɡjumənt/|学业方法|n. 论点，论据|A strong argument needs solid evidence behind the claim.|有力论点需有扎实证据支撑。
revision|/rɪˈvɪʒn/|学业方法|n. 复习|Regular revision helps you remember what you have learned.|定期复习有助记住所学。
formula|/ˈfɔːmjələ/|学业方法|n. 公式|We memorised the formula for that tricky physics problem.|我们记住了那道物理题的公式。
notebook|/ˈnəʊtbʊk/|学业方法|n. 笔记本|She wrote the new words in her small red notebook.|她把生词写在小笔记本里。
handwriting|/ˈhændraɪtɪŋ/|学业方法|n. 书写|His handwriting is clear and easy for us to read.|他的书写清晰易读。
acronym|/ˈækrənɪm/|学业方法|n. 首字母缩略词|NASA is a common acronym that students often hear.|NASA是学生常听的首字母缩略词。
technique|/tekˈniːk/|学业方法|n. 技巧|This reading technique saves time during the big exam.|这阅读技巧在考试中省时。
concentration|/ˌkɒnsnˈtreɪʃn/|学业方法|n. 专注|Good concentration improves the quality of your study.|良好的专注提升学习质量。
focus|/ˈfəʊkəs/|学业方法|v. 集中（注意力）|Focus your mind on the question in front of you now.|把心思集中在面前的题目上。
underline|/ˌʌndəˈlaɪn/|学业方法|v. 在…下划线|Underline the key terms in the reading passage please.|在阅读文章中给关键词划线。
flashcard|/ˈflɑːʃkɑːd/|学业方法|n. 单词卡|I use a flashcard to review words on the bus.|我用单词卡在公交车上复习。
test|/test/|学业方法|n. 测验|The teacher will give us a test on the new unit.|老师将就新单元给我们做一次测验。
assignment|/əˈsaɪnmənt/|学业方法|n. 作业|Finish your writing assignment before the class tomorrow.|明天课前完成你的写作作业。
tutorial|/tjuːˈtɔːriəl/|学业方法|n. 辅导课|The online tutorial explains the steps in a clear way.|在线辅导课清晰地讲解步骤。
seminar|/ˈsemɪnɑː/|学业方法|n. 研讨课|We joined a small seminar to discuss the short story.|我们参加小研讨课讨论这篇短篇故事。
essay|/ˈeseɪ/|学业方法|n. 短文，作文|She wrote a short essay about her favourite festival.|她写了篇关于最喜爱节日的短文。
clue|/kluː/|学业方法|n. 线索|The first sentence gives a useful clue to the answer.|首句为答案提供了有用线索。
hint|/hɪnt/|学业方法|n. 提示|The teacher gave us a hint about the hidden meaning.|老师就隐藏含义给了提示。
tip|/tɪp/|学业方法|n. 窍门|Here is a useful tip for learning new English words.|这是记英语生词的一个实用窍门。
memo|/ˈmeməʊ/|学业方法|n. 备忘录|I left a memo on the desk to remind myself later.|我在桌上留了张备忘录稍作提醒。
topic|/ˈtɒpɪk/|学业方法|n. 话题|Choose a topic that you find interesting and clear.|选一个你觉得有趣又清晰的话题。
point|/pɔɪnt/|学业方法|n. 要点|He made a good point about the cause of the problem.|他就问题成因提了个好要点。
detail|/ˈdiːteɪl/|学业方法|n. 细节|Pay attention to every small detail in the passage.|注意文章里每个细小的地方。
diagram|/ˈdaɪəɡræm/|学业方法|n. 图表|The diagram shows how the water cycle works simply.|图表简明展示了水循环如何运作。
chart|/tʃɑːt/|学业方法|n. 图表|Look at the chart to compare the two results.|看图表比较这两个结果。
table|/ˈteɪbl/|学业方法|n. 表格|Fill in the table with the numbers from the test.|把测验的数字填入表格。
heading|/ˈhedɪŋ/|学业方法|n. 标题|Read the heading to guess what the text is about.|读标题猜测文章讲什么。
title|/ˈtaɪtl/|学业方法|n. 标题|The title of the story tells us the main subject.|故事标题点明了主要题材。
keyword|/ˈkiːwɜːd/|学业方法|n. 关键词|Highlight each keyword so you can find it again.|标出每个关键词以便再找。
target|/ˈtɑːɡɪt/|学业方法|n. 目标|Set a clear target before you begin the reading task.|开始阅读任务前设个清晰目标。
task|/tɑːsk/|学业方法|n. 任务|Our first task is to read the short news report.|我们的首要任务是读这则短新闻。
worksheet|/ˈwɜːkʃiːt/|学业方法|n. 练习单|Complete the worksheet and check your answers twice.|完成练习单并把答案核对两遍。
mood|/muːd/|心理认知|n. 情绪|His happy mood helped the whole group stay relaxed.|他的好心情让全组都放松了。
cognition|/kɒɡˈnɪʃn/|心理认知|n. 认知|Reading trains the cognition needed for hard problems.|阅读训练解决难题所需的认知。
perception|/pəˈsepʃn/|心理认知|n. 感知，看法|Her perception of the event was quite different from mine.|她对这件事的看法和我很不一样。
intuition|/ˌɪntjuˈɪʃn/|心理认知|n. 直觉|I had a strong intuition that the answer was wrong.|我强烈直觉那个答案是错的。
confusion|/kənˈfjuːʒn/|心理认知|n. 困惑|The unclear rule caused real confusion among the students.|模糊的规则让学生真感到困惑。
curiosity|/ˌkjʊəriˈɒsəti/|心理认知|n. 好奇心|Her curiosity led her to read many books on space.|好奇心驱使她读了很多太空书。
esteem|/ɪˈstiːm/|心理认知|n. 自尊|A small success can raise a student's sense of esteem.|小小的成功能提升学生的自尊心。
frustration|/frʌˈstreɪʃn/|心理认知|n. 挫折|He felt frustration when the code would not run.|代码跑不起来时他感到受挫。
satisfaction|/ˌsætɪsˈfækʃn/|心理认知|n. 满足|She felt deep satisfaction after finishing the long essay.|写完长文后她感到深深的满足。
disappointment|/ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntmənt/|心理认知|n. 失望|His disappointment showed when he lost the match.|输掉比赛时他的失望显露出来。
excitement|/ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/|心理认知|n. 兴奋|The news brought excitement to the whole classroom.|这消息让全班都兴奋起来。
calm|/kɑːm/|心理认知|adj. 平静的|Stay calm and read the question one more time slowly.|保持冷静，再把题目慢慢读一遍。
alert|/əˈlɜːt/|心理认知|adj. 警觉的|You should stay alert during the final part of the test.|考试最后部分你应保持警觉。
conscious|/ˈkɒnʃəs/|心理认知|adj. 有意识的|He was conscious that his reply was not quite right.|他意识到自己的回答不太对。
rational|/ˈræʃnəl/|心理认知|adj. 理性的|We need a rational reason, not just a quick feeling.|我们需要理性理由，而非一时感觉。
logical|/ˈlɒdʒɪkl/|心理认知|adj. 合乎逻辑的|Her answer was clear and logical from start to finish.|她的回答从头到尾清晰而合乎逻辑。
emotional|/ɪˈməʊʃənl/|心理认知|adj. 情绪的|The speech was very emotional and moved many students.|演讲很动情，感动了许多学生。
sensitive|/ˈsensətɪv/|心理认知|adj. 敏感的|He is sensitive to criticism from his close friends.|他对好友的批评很敏感。
sensible|/ˈsensəbl/|心理认知|adj. 明智的|It is sensible to check your work before you submit.|交稿前检查作业是明智的。
mature|/məˈtʃʊə/|心理认知|adj. 成熟的|She gave a mature reply that surprised the whole class.|她给出成熟答复，让全班惊讶。
impatient|/ɪmˈpeɪʃnt/|心理认知|adj. 不耐烦的|Do not be impatient; good reading takes real time.|别不耐烦，好的阅读需要时间。
embarrassed|/ɪmˈbærəst/|心理认知|adj. 尴尬的|He felt embarrassed when he forgot the new word.|忘了生词时他感到尴尬。
ashamed|/əˈʃeɪmd/|心理认知|adj. 羞愧的|She was ashamed of the careless mistake she made.|她为自己粗心的错误感到羞愧。
guilty|/ˈɡɪlti/|心理认知|adj. 内疚的|I felt guilty for not helping with the group task.|没帮上小组任务我感到内疚。
enthusiastic|/ɪnˌθjuːziˈæstɪk/|心理认知|adj. 热情的|The teacher was enthusiastic about our new project.|老师对我们的新项目很热情。
bored|/bɔːd/|心理认知|adj. 厌倦的|The long lecture left some students feeling rather bored.|冗长讲座让一些学生颇感厌倦。
boring|/ˈbɔːrɪŋ/|心理认知|adj. 无聊的|The film was boring and we left before the end.|电影很无聊，我们提前离场。
motivated|/ˈməʊtɪveɪtɪd/|心理认知|adj. 有动力的|A clear goal keeps a learner strongly motivated each day.|清晰目标让学习者每天动力十足。
depressed|/dɪˈprest/|心理认知|adj. 沮丧的|He felt depressed after failing the important exam.|重要考试失利后他很沮丧。
cheerful|/ˈtʃɪəfl/|心理认知|adj. 开朗的|Her cheerful voice made the quiet room feel warm.|她开朗的声音让安静的房间温暖起来。
thoughtful|/ˈθɔːtfl/|心理认知|adj. 深思的|He gave a thoughtful answer that showed real care.|他给出深思的回答，显出真心关怀。
distracted|/dɪˈstræktɪd/|心理认知|adj. 分心的|She was distracted by the noise from the next room.|她被隔壁房间的噪音分了神。
attentive|/əˈtentɪv/|心理认知|adj. 专注的|An attentive reader notices the small changes in tone.|专注的读者会留意语气的小变化。
mindful|/ˈmaɪndfl/|心理认知|adj. 留心的|Be mindful of the time when you write the response.|写回答时要留意时间。
insecure|/ˌɪnsɪˈkjʊə/|心理认知|adj. 缺乏自信的|He felt insecure about speaking in front of others.|在众人面前说话他缺乏自信。
inspired|/ɪnˈspaɪəd/|心理认知|adj. 受启发的|We were inspired by the story of the young scientist.|年轻科学家的故事启发了我们。
intrigued|/ɪnˈtriːɡd/|心理认知|adj. 好奇的|I was intrigued by the strange custom in the text.|文中奇特的风俗让我好奇。
puzzled|/ˈpʌzld/|心理认知|adj. 困惑的|She looked puzzled when the teacher asked the question.|老师提问时她一脸困惑。
relieved|/rɪˈliːvd/|心理认知|adj. 宽慰的|He felt relieved after the result of the test came out.|测验结果出来后他松了口气。
anxious|/ˈæŋkʃəs/|心理认知|adj. 焦虑的|Many students feel anxious before a big public speech.|许多学生在大演讲前感到焦虑。
restless|/ˈrestləs/|心理认知|adj. 不安的|The long wait made the children feel restless and loud.|久等让孩子们躁动又吵闹。
mindset|/ˈmaɪndset/|心理认知|n. 心态|A growth mindset helps you learn from your mistakes.|成长型心态帮你从错误中学习。
feeling|/ˈfiːlɪŋ/|心理认知|n. 感觉|I had a strange feeling that something was not right.|我有一种异样感觉，好像哪里不对。
willpower|/ˈwɪlpaʊə/|心理认知|n. 意志力|It takes willpower to study when you feel so tired.|疲惫时学习需要意志力。
imagination|/ɪˌmædʒɪˈneɪʃn/|心理认知|n. 想象力|Her imagination made the plain story feel alive.|她的想象让平淡故事活了起来。
creativity|/ˌkriːeɪˈtɪvəti/|心理认知|n. 创造力|The task gave us space to show our real creativity.|这任务给了我们展现创造力的空间。
intelligence|/ɪnˈtelɪdʒəns/|心理认知|n. 智力|Hard work matters more than raw intelligence alone.|努力比单纯智力更重要。
wisdom|/ˈwɪzdəm/|心理认知|n. 智慧|The old tale teaches us a simple piece of wisdom.|古老故事教给我们朴素智慧。
patience|/ˈpeɪʃns/|心理认知|n. 耐心|It takes patience to learn a language step by step.|循序渐进学语言需要耐心。
empathy|/ˈempəθi/|心理认知|n. 同理心|Empathy helps us understand how others may feel.|同理心帮我们理解他人感受。
sympathy|/ˈsɪmpəθi/|心理认知|n. 同情|We felt sympathy for the family after the flood.|洪灾后我们对这家人深感同情。
gratitude|/ˈɡrætɪtjuːd/|心理认知|n. 感激|She wrote a note of gratitude to her kind teacher.|她给善良的老师写了感谢信。
desire|/dɪˈzaɪə/|心理认知|n. 渴望|He had a strong desire to learn the guitar well.|他强烈渴望学好吉他。
ambition|/æmˈbɪʃn/|心理认知|n. 抱负|Her ambition is to study medicine at a good university.|她的抱负是进好大学学医。
passion|/ˈpæʃn/|心理认知|n. 热情|He spoke with real passion about protecting the river.|他满腔热情地谈保护这条河。
joy|/dʒɔɪ/|心理认知|n. 喜悦|The little gift brought quiet joy to the sick child.|小礼物给病童带来平静的喜悦。
grief|/ɡriːf/|心理认知|n. 悲伤|The book describes the grief of losing a close friend.|书描写了失去挚友的悲伤。
fear|/fɪə/|心理认知|n. 恐惧|Her fear of failure stopped her from trying the task.|对失败的恐惧让她不敢尝试。
temperament|/ˈtempərəmənt/|心理认知|n. 性情|His calm temperament suits the work of a nurse.|他沉静的性情适合做护士。
longing|/ˈlɒŋɪŋ/|心理认知|n. 渴望|He felt a quiet longing for the summer holidays to come.|他静静地盼着暑假到来。
although|/ɔːlˈðəʊ/|逻辑关系|conj. 尽管|Although it rained, we still went out to play.|尽管下雨，我们仍出去玩了。
despite|/dɪˈspaɪt/|逻辑关系|prep. 尽管|Despite the noise, she kept reading her book calmly.|尽管有噪音，她仍安静地读书。
so|/səʊ/|逻辑关系|conj. 所以|The light went out, so we lit a small candle.|灯灭了，所以我们点了支蜡烛。
thus|/ðʌs/|逻辑关系|adv. 因此|The data was weak; thus the claim was hard to prove.|数据薄弱，因此该主张难以证实。
whereby|/weəˈbaɪ/|逻辑关系|adv. 借此|We found a method whereby the cost could be cut.|我们找到能借此降低成本的方法。
wherein|/weərˈɪn/|逻辑关系|adv. 在其中|He described a case wherein the rule did not apply.|他描述了该规则不适用的情形。
provided|/prəˈvaɪdɪd/|逻辑关系|conj. 假如|We can go out provided that you finish your work.|只要你完成作业，我们就可以出去。
supposing|/səˈpəʊzɪŋ/|逻辑关系|conj. 假设|Supposing it snows, what will the school do then?|假设下雪，学校到时会怎么办？
given|/ˈɡɪvn/|逻辑关系|prep. 考虑到|Given the facts, her answer was the right one.|考虑到事实，她的回答是对的。
considering|/kənˈsɪdərɪŋ/|逻辑关系|prep. 考虑到|Considering the time, we should stop and rest.|考虑到时间，我们该停下休息。
whilst|/waɪlst/|逻辑关系|conj. 虽然|Whilst he read, she wrote notes in her notebook.|他读书时，她在笔记本上写笔记。
accordingly|/əˈkɔːdɪŋli/|逻辑关系|adv. 因此|The plan failed; accordingly, we made a new one.|计划失败，因此我们制定了新方案。
